subject: health
title: Launch and diagnostic: dimensions and determinants of health
essentialQuestion: How can understanding health literacy, systems, and support help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?
materials: unit-specific source, model, manipulatives, safe materials, or approved digital tool
keyPoints: Health reflects physical, mental, emotional, and social factors plus conditions such as safety, housing, access, culture, and environment; these determinants affect options without defining a person.
A defensible community response uses accurate data, identifies the actor with authority, proposes a feasible change, protects privacy and access, and defines how progress will be measured.
For dimensions and determinants of health, a strong response distinguishes fact from assumption, uses a fictional or public case, and includes a safe next step or appropriate source of support.
privacySafeScenario: Create a health-information verification protocol and support map using fictional examples.
studentTask: Draft a one-page fictional community response about dimensions and determinants of health: state the condition with two facts, identify who has authority to act, propose one feasible change, name a privacy or access safeguard, and define one measure that would show progress.
knowledgeCheck: In two or three sentences, explain the most important distinction in dimensions and determinants of health; use one lesson fact and name the evidence, safety check, or support route that makes the explanation dependable.
completionCriteria: The response completes every named part of the dimensions and determinants of health task using the supplied fictional or public case.
The response uses at least two accurate details from the lesson instruction and distinguishes evidence from assumption.
The response gives a safe, feasible next step or support route and does not depend on private disclosure, body comparison, or recorded media proof.
